instruction: A candid documentary wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet, white walls, and dark red partitions in the background. On the left, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing right, reaching her right hand to touch the left shoulder of the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1), who stands on the right facing her. The scene is lit by overhead fluorescent lights, creating a neutral, bright atmosphere with soft shadows.
